_comment: Settings for the verbformen.de sync. Edit values here; no code changes needed.
_archive_comment: Raw pages are 30-40 KB each, so only these levels keep a copy in archive/ (the word data is saved for all levels).

http._speed_comment: 4.5-5.5 s between requests = about 12 per minute. verbformen started refusing requests at around 20 per minute, so keep it here.

health._comment: Daily check: words found on verbformen vs local files vs Supabase. A mismatch triggers a repair.
